svg.data-what: a long bone cut lengthwise: cartilage-capped ends of spongy bone and red marrow, growth plates, and a shaft of compact bone around a cavity of yellow marrow

path.data-what: compact bone, the dense wall of the shaft, built of osteons around tiny canals
red marrow, filling the spaces of the spongy bone in the ends: it makes the blood cells
spongy (trabecular) bone, a lattice of thin struts in the ends of the bone, its spaces filled with red marrow
the medullary cavity of the shaft, filled with yellow marrow, mostly fat in adults

g.data-what: the growth plates (epiphyseal plates), discs of cartilage where the bone grows in length until the end of adolescence; they then close into a line
articular cartilage, the smooth slippery cap of each end, where the bone meets the next one in a joint
the periosteum, the living membrane around the bone, with the cells that thicken it and the vessels and nerves that enter it
the nutrient artery, entering the shaft through a small hole to feed the marrow and the inner bone

path.data-what: the proximal epiphysis, the upper end of the bone
the metaphysis, the flaring zone between the end and the shaft
the diaphysis, the shaft of the bone
the metaphysis at the lower end
the distal epiphysis, the lower end of the bone
